proposed.sourceName: South African National Halaal Authority (SANHA) — E470b Magnesium Salts of Fatty Acids
proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies E470b (magnesium salts of fatty acids / magnesium stearate) as Mushbooh (doubtful): the fatty acids may be plant- or animal-derived, so the source must be checked to determine halal status.

proposed.sourceName: SeekersGuidance — 'Is It Permissible to Use Products That Contain Stearic Acid?' (Ustadh Salman Younas)
proposed.paraphrase: A Hanafi answer holding that products containing stearic acid / magnesium stearate are permissible even if the source could be animal (including non-halal), because the substance has undergone an essential chemical change (istihalat al-'ayn); it adds that using a product made only from permissible sources remains superior.

researcherNote: E470 seeded general grade 3 (contested) — genuine contest: SANHA classifies E470b mushbooh (verify source) while SeekersGuidance permits it via istihalat al-'ayn. Two independent tier-1. APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
